description: This file contains unit tests for the LocationHandler class in an Android application, verifying location permission handling, provider selection, and error scenarios using a fake data source.

classes.name: LocationHandlerTest
classes.description: Test class for LocationHandler, utilizing a fake data source to simulate different permission and location scenarios.

classes.name: FakeLocationDataSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of LocationDataSource used for testing, providing controlled responses and simulating permission states and failures.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_requiresLocationPermissionWhenNeitherFineNorCoarse
methods.description: Tests that the handler correctly requires location permission when neither fine nor coarse location permission is granted.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_requiresForegroundBeforeLocationPermission
methods.description: Ensures that foreground permission is checked before location permission retrieval.

methods.name: hasFineLocationPermission_reflectsDataSource
methods.description: Verifies that the permission check methods reflect the state of the data source.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_usesPreciseGpsFirstWhenFinePermissionAndPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Tests that the handler requests GPS provider when fine permission and precise location are enabled.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_fallsBackToBalancedWhenPreciseUnavailable
methods.description: Ensures fallback to balanced provider when precise GPS is unavailable.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_mapsTimeoutToLocationTimeout
methods.description: Verifies that a timeout maps to a LOCATION_TIMEOUT error.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_mapsOtherFailuresToLocationUnavailable
methods.description: Checks that general failures are mapped to LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE errors.
